Formé à Paris, proche des avant-gardes sans jamais s’y perdre, Étienne Terrus a fait le choix d’un ancrage territorial fort.\\n\\nIl revient très tôt à Elne, sa ville natale, où il développe une peinture de paysage subtile, inspirée par la lumière méridionale, et teintée d’une modernité silencieuse. Figure du pays, il est un intime d’Aristide Maillol qui réalise son portrait en buste, œuvre présentée dans le parcours permanent du musée Rigaud.\\n\\nLe sculpteur évoquait ainsi les qualités de Terrus : « C’était un peintre,vous savez. Il avait un sentiment tellement délicat du paysage …. Il a fait des aquarelles comme personne n’en fait, des merveilles (…) Dans ce qu’il fait, tous les tons sont sentis. Toutes les touches sont vivantes. C’est comme les notes de Mozart. Il n’y en a pas une qui ne chante »\\n(Henri Frère, Conversations de Maillol, Genève [1956], 2016, p. 96)."},{"t":1,"s":"Expo"},{"t":1,"s":"2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2027-04-30T15:30:00.000Z"},{"t":9,"i":2,"a":[{"t":1,"s":"2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2027-01-01T10:00:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2027-01-01T13:30:00.000Z"}],"o":0},{"t":9,"i":3,"a":[{"t":10,"i":4,"p":{"k":["debut","fin","heureFiable"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2026-12-31T16:30:00.000Z"},{"t":2,"s":2}]},"o":0},{"t":10,"i":5,"p":{"k":["debut","fin","heureFiable"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"2027-01-01T10:00:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2027-04-30T15:30:00.000Z"},{"t":2,"s":2}]},"o":0},{"t":10,"i":6,"p":{"k":["debut","fin","heureFiable"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"2027-01-01T13:30:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2027-04-30T15:30:00.000Z"},{"t":2,"s":2}]},"o":0}],"o":0},{"t":10,"i":7,"p":{"k":["name","commune","insee","codePostal","lat","lng"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":""},{"t":1,"s":"Perpignan"},{"t":1,"s":"66136"},{"t":1,"s":"66000"},{"t":0,"s":42.6979832},{"t":0,"s":2.892973}]},"o":0},{"t":10,"i":8,"p":{"k":["url","mesure"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"https://cdt66.media.tourinsoft.eu/upload/EXPO---ETIENNE-TERRUS---2026-et-2027.jpg"},{"t":10,"i":9,"p":{"k":["largeur","hauteur"],"v":[{"t":0,"s":1024},{"t":0,"s":768}]},"o":0}]},"o":0},{"t":1,"s":"https://www.musee-rigaud.fr/"},{"t":2,"s":0},{"t":2,"s":3},{"t":0,"s":85},{"t":1,"s":"Tourinsoft (CDT66 — Fêtes)"},{"t":1,"s":"structured"},{"t":1,"s":"declaree"},{"t":1,"s":"exposition"},{"t":10,"i":10,"p":{"k":["etat","champ"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"payant_montant_inconnu"},{"t":1,"s":"DETAILFETEPAYANTE"}]},"o":0}]},"o":0},{"t":2,"s":1},{"t":11,"i":11,"p":{"k":[],"v":[]},"o":0}]},"o":0}
